fusions.name: Branching Bruise
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then branch out to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Splitting Crack
fusions.desc: Splits the ground ahead of you in a wide fork 4 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Back-and-Fore
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Other Tine
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
